data.name: AiSettings.AdvancedNote
data.value: This screen talks to the real gateway settings. Changes take effect immediately and only after the service confirms them.

data.name: AiSettings.Status.NotVerified
data.value: Not verified — this install has never seen a successful check

data.name: AiSettings.EnableNote
data.value: When off, every insight stays rule-based. AI also needs your processing consent below.

data.name: AiSettings.TestUnavailableNote
data.value: No connection tester is registered in this build — the live probe has not been merged yet.

data.name: AiSettings.Test.Ok
data.value: The gateway answered this check. Verification is now recorded.

data.name: AiSettings.Test.Fail
data.value: The gateway did not answer this check. Nothing was verified.

data.name: AiSettings.Key.Note
data.value: Optional. A key you enter here replaces the built-in one and is stored encrypted on this device only. Save an empty box? Use “Back to built-in” instead.

data.name: AiSettings.Key.Saved
data.value: Your key was saved for this device.

data.name: AiSettings.Key.Empty
data.value: Type a key first — or use “Back to built-in” to clear your override.

data.name: AiSettings.Insecure.Body
data.value: The gateway is reachable over plain HTTP: anything sent could be read on the network. Keep AI off unless you accept that risk, and never send data you would not want exposed.

data.name: AiSettings.Consent.Note
data.value: Every category starts as never-asked, which behaves like denied. Flipping a switch records your explicit answer; a “never asked” label disappears once you do.

data.name: AiSettings.Consent.AiProcessingNote
data.value: Send a minimal summary of your state to the AI gateway for interpretation. The raw key never travels from this device beyond the gateway call itself.

data.name: AiSettings.Consent.HealthDataNote
data.value: Let features read your sleep and recovery history. Stays on this device; AI only ever receives the minimal derived summary above, and only with that consent too.

data.name: AiSettings.Consent.ActivityDataNote
data.value: Let features read steps and workouts. Stays on this device.

data.name: AiSettings.Consent.NotificationsNote
data.value: Allow LIVORA to remind you locally. The system permission prompt is separate and is only asked for on the Reminders screen.

data.name: AiSettings.Cloud.Note
data.value: This card reports the account backend's real state. There is no sign-in form because there is nothing to sign in to yet — your data lives on this device.

data.name: AiSettings.Failed
data.value: That did not go through. Nothing was changed.

data.name: DataStudio.AdvancedBanner
data.value: Advanced: this screen edits the raw JSON your app actually stores. Wrong shapes can break trends and plans. If you were not told to be here, go back.

data.name: DataStudio.Warning.Title
data.value: You are editing stored data directly

data.name: DataStudio.Warning.Body
data.value: Changes here are not validated by the normal UI — the store's own rules are the last line of defense. Export a backup first if the data matters to you.

data.name: DataStudio.NoKinds
data.value: The data catalog returned no kinds yet.

data.name: DataStudio.NothingLoaded
data.value: Nothing loaded yet. Pick a kind, type an id, then press Load.

data.name: DataStudio.Failed
data.value: The operation failed. Nothing was changed.

data.name: DataStudio.ConfirmDelete.Body
data.value: {0} “{1}” will be removed from local storage. This cannot be undone.

data.name: DataStudio.ExportAll.Note
data.value: Writes the whole local store as one JSON file into this app's data folder and shows the real path. No cloud, no network.

data.name: DataStudio.ImportAll.Note
data.value: Reads a full-export JSON file from a path on this device and replaces or merges your store according to the switch below.

data.name: DataStudio.Merge
data.value: Merge into existing data (off = replace everything)

data.name: DataStudio.PathMissing
data.value: That file could not be read. Check the path — this build takes a full path typed here, not a folder picker.

data.name: Lock.PinNote
data.value: A 4-digit code protects this app on the device. It is stored only as a hash here and never sent anywhere.

data.name: Lock.Mismatch
data.value: The two entries didn't match. Choose your code again.

data.name: Lock.SetDone
data.value: Code set. The app will ask for it next launch.

data.name: Lock.SetFailed
data.value: The code could not be saved on this device.

data.name: Lock.Removed
data.value: The code was removed from this device.

data.name: Settings.AiEntryNote
data.value: Gateway status, your key, data consent

data.name: Settings.DataStudioEntryNote
data.value: Advanced: raw entity editing, backup and restore
